angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 291,498 km at 26.09 pc = 0.15 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 38.3269 +/- 0.0155 mas (same row, RUWE 1.16): 26.09 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.419 +/- 0.028 solar radii from Lacedelli et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-912 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...705A.260L/abstract): 291,498 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.418 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Lacedelli et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-912 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...705A.260L/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3572 +/- 100 K from Lacedelli et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-912 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...705A.260L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Lacedelli et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-912 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...705A.260L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-912.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.815, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-912 (pscomppars): spectral type M3, from Lacedelli et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...705A.260L/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-912 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.19 dex, from Lacedelli et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...705A.260L/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-912 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.59007, from Lacedelli et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...705A.260L/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-912 (pscomppars): age 0.8 Gyr, from Lacedelli et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...705A.260L/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-912 (pscomppars): rotation period 45.9 d, from Lacedelli et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...705A.260L/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
